Congress holds student marathon in Ranchi protesting exam leaks

The Congress party organized a student marathon in Ranchi, Jharkhand, to protest against alleged exam paper leaks. The event aimed to raise awareness and demand action regarding the integrity of examination processes. This demonstration highlights concerns over educational fairness and accountability.
